# Golden Hour Unboxed

> A free, all-ages, cross-cultural evening celebrating Black entrepreneurship on the Eastside, held during National Black Business Month. Sunday, August 23, 2026 at Bellevue Botanical Garden (Aaron Education Center), 12001 Main St, Bellevue, WA. Doors open at 5:30 PM; program runs 6:00–9:00 PM. Produced by ToyBox Consulting & Management as part of the City of Bellevue's Cross-Cultural Center without Walls.

## Event essentials

- **Date:** Sunday, August 23, 2026
- **Time:** Doors 5:30 PM · Program 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM · Twilight social to 9:15 PM
- **Venue:** Bellevue Botanical Garden — Aaron Education Center, 12001 Main St, Bellevue, WA 98005
- **Cost:** Free · All ages welcome
- **RSVP:** https://www.eventbrite.com/e/golden-hour-tickets-1982307398792
- **Overflow parking:** WISC (Wilburton Instructional Service Center), 12241 Main St, Bellevue, WA 98005 — short walk east on Main Street
- **Website:** https://goldenhourunboxed.com/
- **Contact:** katoya@toyboxconsulting.net

## What happens

- **Sunset Sounds** — acoustic music, spoken word, movement from cross-cultural artists
- **Storytelling** — personal narratives from Eastside voices
- **Micro Speed Pitching Showcase** — 2-minute pitches from emerging Black entrepreneurs
- **Pack-the-Box Drive** — back-to-school supply collection for local Title I students
- **Twilight Social** — unhurried gathering as the sky turns lavender and gold
- **Vendor Village** — 15 Black-owned businesses + 5 community organizations tabling on-site

## FAQ (frequently asked)

- **Cost:** Free to attend. RSVP appreciated for planning.
- **Family-friendly:** Yes, all ages welcome, cross-generational programming.
- **Arrive early:** Yes — the Botanical Garden is open all afternoon; wander the gardens before the Ed Center doors open at 5:30 PM.
- **Parking:** Overflow parking at WISC, 12241 Main St. Short walk east on Main.
- **Accessibility:** Bellevue Botanical Garden has accessible pathways and seating. Contact katoya@toyboxconsulting.net for specific accommodations.
- **Rain plan:** Covered options at the venue; the date is firm.
- **Dress:** Garden casual, layers for twilight, shoes you can stroll in.
- **Tabling:** Vendor applications closed July 20. Missed the deadline? Sign up as a Storyteller through the Pitch & Storyteller form.

## Optional

Held during National Black Business Month (August). Part of a pilot program within Bellevue's Diversity Advantage Initiative, anchored in the Diversity Advantage Plan 2025–2035. One of twenty-seven Bellevue-based organizations producing more than seventy cross-cultural events citywide in 2026 through the program.
